policy: Supplemental B-bucket PDC inventory for Electroverse locations that aggregate more than one physical national station. Extensions are location-locked, backed by current PAN evidence, and only add currently unowned national PDCs. They do not replace the primary mapped station.

evidence.note: At ~48 m from the Electroverse aggregate location, PAN exposes current station FRSRGP90119496 with four PDCs whose local family is B043: two 17.94 kW Type2 and two 3.68 kW EF. The four PDCs are unowned by any existing Electroverse mapping. Legacy PAN rows at the same site also expose stationLocal B043.
